title: Spring publishes advisories for Spring Security, Spring LDAP and Spring Boot, two rated critical
summary: Spring's advisories of 19 November rate CVE-2026-59367 (a hardcoded administrator credential on an embedded test LDAP server in Spring LDAP) and CVE-2026-59411 (default servlet security disabled for Actuator apps on Cloud Foundry in Spring Boot) as critical. CVE-2026-59273, which can allow remote code execution in Spring Security, is rated medium. heise says the developers cite no ongoing attacks.
plain: Spring has published advisories for Spring Security, Spring LDAP and Spring Boot, two rated critical; heise says the developers report no ongoing attacks.
exec: Spring rates two of three flaws in Java framework components critical and lists fixes; heise says no attacks are reported.
action: Spring advises upgrading: open-source fixes are Spring Security 7.1.3 or 7.0.9, Spring LDAP 4.1.3 or 4.0.7, Spring Boot 4.1.3 or 4.0.10; other lines' fixes need Enterprise Support.

validation.note: Spring's own advisory pages are primary; heise Security independently reports the same flaws.

review.note: stronger than the source: Spring page rates CVE-2026-59273 MEDIUM, only the LDAP and Boot flaws are critical; title, summary, plain, exec fixed; correction file added
